# Reviu.store — llms.txt
# https://llmstxt.org — machine-readable context for AI assistants

## Product
- Name: Reviu.store
- URL: https://reviu.store
- Category: SaaS / E-commerce Tool
- Target Users: Amazon and Shopify sellers in India

## What Reviu Does
Reviu is a smart QR-code-based review collection system for online marketplace sellers.
Sellers generate a unique QR code per product and place it inside the product box (e.g. on a business card or insert).
When a buyer scans the QR code, they are taken to a custom feedback form.
- If the buyer is happy (high rating), they are redirected to the product's Amazon review page to leave a public review.
- If the buyer is unhappy (low rating), their feedback is captured privately and sent to the seller — preventing negative public reviews.

## Key Features
- Custom branded feedback forms per product/campaign
- Unique QR code generation per product
- Intelligent review routing (positive → Amazon, negative → private)
- Scan tracking and analytics dashboard
- 100% Amazon Terms of Service (TOS) compliant
- Data privacy compliant (GDPR + Indian IT Act)
- Built specifically for Indian Amazon & Shopify sellers

## Compliance
Reviu does NOT incentivize reviews, offer discounts in exchange for reviews, or manipulate Amazon ratings.
All review solicitation is done transparently, following Amazon's Community Guidelines and Seller Code of Conduct.

## Pricing
- Free trial available
- Paid plans available (contact via https://reviu.store/#contact)
- Indian payment methods supported

## Contact
- Website: https://reviu.store
- API endpoint: https://scanqrgo.onrender.com/api/connect
- Location: India

## Pages
- / — Main landing page (product overview, how it works, testimonials, contact form)
- /amazon-review-qr-code — SEO landing page for Amazon review QR code queries
- /login — Seller login
- /register — New seller registration
- /campaign/:id — Public customer-facing feedback form (QR scan destination)

## Tech Stack (for developers / AI agents)
- Frontend: React (Vite), vanilla CSS
- Backend: Node.js / Express
- Database: MongoDB Atlas
- Hosting: Vercel (frontend), Render (backend)
